introduction: This level focuses on the most revolutionary and complex technologies of the 21st century, which have made medical miracles—like curing genetic diseases—a real possibility.

core_concepts.title: CRISPR-Cas9 Technology
core_concepts.description:
One of the greatest discoveries of modern science, widely known as **'Molecular Scissors'**. 
Function: It allows scientists to target a specific sequence of DNA with extreme precision to 'Cut', 'Remove', or 'Paste' new genes. It holds the potential to cure genetic diseases, sickle cell anemia, and certain cancers. (Inventors won the 2020 Nobel Prize in Chemistry).

core_concepts.title: Stem Cells
core_concepts.description:
Stem cells are the 'master cells' or raw materials of the human body. 
Specialty: Unlike a heart cell or brain cell that has only one specific job, stem cells have the unique ability to develop into **ANY type of cell** in the body (a property called Pluripotency). They are used in regenerative medicine to grow new tissues and repair damaged organs.

core_concepts.title: DNA Fingerprinting (Profiling)
core_concepts.description:
The DNA of any two human beings is 99.9% identical. However, the remaining 0.1% is absolutely 'Unique' to each individual. The technique of analyzing this unique 0.1% sequence to identify criminals or determine paternity is called DNA Fingerprinting. 
Father of DNA Fingerprinting in India: **Dr. Lalji Singh** (CCMB, Hyderabad).

core_concepts.title: Nanomedicine: Targeted Drug Delivery
core_concepts.description: In traditional cancer treatment (Chemotherapy), the drugs kill both tumor cells and healthy cells indiscriminately. Using Nanotechnology, scientists are creating nanobots or smart nanoparticles that carry the medicine directly into the bloodstream, ignore all healthy cells, and attach **EXCLUSIVELY to the cancer/tumor cells** to deliver the payload (Targeted Delivery).

important_entities.name: Cas9
important_entities.significance: In the CRISPR-Cas9 system, 'Cas9' is the actual enzyme (a type of protein) that acts as the molecular scissors, physically cutting the two strands of the DNA molecule.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exam Trap: Physical fingerprints on your hands can be altered or destroyed by acid or surgery. However, 'DNA Fingerprinting' is extracted from blood, hair follicles, saliva, or skin cells, and a person's DNA sequence can NEVER be altered.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Just as you use Cut and Paste shortcuts to edit text on a computer, the CRISPR technology allows scientists to literally Cut and Paste genetic code inside a living body.

exam_strategy_tips: Frequently asked in UPSC and NDA: 'The term CRISPR-Cas9, often mentioned in the news, is associated with?' Answer: Gene editing / Molecular scissors.
